whenToUse: An engineering or developer blog with code samples, tags, authors and a keyboard-first post index.
Teams that publish code in several languages and want samples to switch together.
avoidWhen: A literary or design magazine — use site-blog-01.
a11y: Has skip links and keyboard shortcuts (/ to filter, j / k to move); filter results are announced in status regions.
Shortcuts are ignored while typing in fields; document them on the page for keyboard users.
